info.title: МедТермин API
info.description: Appointment scheduling and clinic platform API. Sign in through /api/auth/login (or /api/platform/login for company operations), copy accessToken, then use Authorize. These are opaque session tokens, not JWTs. Clinic operations also require the X-Clinic header. Try it out calls the real API and can change data according to the signed-in account's permissions.

parameters.name: X-Clinic
parameters.description: Clinic identifier, for example main. Must match the clinic session. Registration also uses this header.
